### Meaning
| infl. | class | meaning                          |
| ----- | ----- | -------------------------------- |
| ~     | *n.*  | back, backbone, spine, vertebrae |
### Implied meaning
- structure
- stature
- posterior side
### Etymology
#### Glyph
pictograph of an upright spine with legs and shoulders (from the brain stem to the tailbone). Similar to 呂.
#### Sound
- *a priori:* b=solidity, en=connective
